candidate_workaround: Use subprocess communicate with the complete request payload so input and output are drained concurrently, then parse every returned blob deterministically.
failure_signature: The first read-only exact-manifest helper wrote every blob request before draining batch output, filled the child output pipe, and timed out without a result.
recurrence_guard: Never manually write a large cat-file batch to a piped child without concurrent output draining.
rollback: Give the failed attempt no proof credit, retain it, and rely only on a bounded passing witness.
scope_boundary: Bounded owner-scoped recovery only; no independent reproduction or authority credit.
title: Recover cat_file_batch_pipe_deadlock without erasing its failed witness
